name: American Home Shield ShieldSilver Plan

price.headline: From $29.99 per month
price.note: Service call fee of $75, $100, or $125 per visit, chosen at enrollment. Higher service fee = lower monthly premium.

key_facts.label: Covered systems
key_facts.value: Heating, electrical, plumbing, and more depending on plan

key_facts.label: Covered appliances
key_facts.value: Optional add-on or included in higher-tier plans

key_facts.label: Coverage limit
key_facts.value: Varies by component; some limits apply

pros: Covers major home systems and appliances in one plan
Claims available 24/7 online or by phone
cons: Some repairs have dollar caps that may not cover full replacement cost
Service fee adds to the cost of each claim
best_for: homeowners with older systems who want a known monthly cost for unexpected repairs
skip_if: your home is newer and systems are still under manufacturer warranty
rating_reason: Wide coverage and established network, but per-claim service fees and coverage caps can reduce the value for smaller repairs. Read the contract carefully before enrolling.
